audit_items.proof_trace: The exchange_rate() function directly computes (cash_plus_borrows_minus_reserves) / total_supply, making the formula tautologically correct. Every state-mutating operation (mint, burn, borrow, repay, accrue_interest, liquidate, take_revenue, flash loans) consistently maintains cash, debt, cash_reserve, and total_supply: borrow shifts amount from cash to debt with zero net effect on the numerator; repay is the inverse; accrual increases debt and cash_reserve by proportional amounts; integer floor divisions in mint/burn/liquidate can only increase the rate, never decrease it. No operation can produce a state where the computed formula diverges from the actual backing value.
